column4: [A2-01] Gateway crashes at startup on PostgreSQL
column14:
FOUND IN: Integration audit 2 (2026-11-04, main @ daaee87), docs/testing/audit-2-integration.md (defect A2-01)
SEVERITY: Blocker    FIXED BY: slice-34-local-demo-stack (SCRUM-44) — link this bug to SCRUM-44 with 'Relates'

STEPS TO REPRODUCE:
# Start the gateway against PostgreSQL (DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://...).

ACTUAL: Application startup fails: recover_stale_jobs() binds a timezone-aware datetime to a TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE column and asyncpg raises DataError. Tests use SQLite, which accepts it, so CI is green.

EXPECTED: The gateway starts on PostgreSQL; retraining timestamps are naive UTC like every other column.

WHERE: backend/app/services/retraining_service.py:31-32

column4: [A2-03] Every IT custom action fails: quoted action endpoint is never expanded

column4: [A2-20] Form answers report the intent of the message that started the form
column14:
FOUND IN: Integration audit 2 (2026-11-04, main @ daaee87), docs/testing/audit-2-integration.md (defect A2-20)
SEVERITY: Minor    FIXED BY: slice-32-rasa-contract-v2 (SCRUM-42) — link this bug to SCRUM-42 with 'Relates'

STEPS TO REPRODUCE:
# Run a pack with Rasa's in-memory tracker store (no tracker_store, or Postgres unreachable when Rasa starts).
# Say "my laptop screen is broken", then "cancel", then "hardware".

ACTUAL: Every reply reports raise_ticket 0.97: the channel reads tracker.latest_message from a tracker rebuilt from applied events, and Rasa folds happy-path form turns out of those. The gateway stores and logs the wrong intent, confidence and entities for each form answer.

EXPECTED: The reply describes the message just handled (cancel 0.76, then inform 1.0).

WHERE: rasa-shared/vario_rasa/channel.py (tracker.latest_message)
